```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
source("R/release.R")
v <- read.csv(VARIABLES_FILE)
codes <- release_codes()
# underscores in the descriptions stay underscores, not emphasis
esc <- function(x) gsub("_", "\\\\_", x)
```

The variables, codes and keys of the published files of a release:
`course_offerings`, `course_plans` and `plan_sections`, of both frames
(all courses and the teacher-ed frame; [Data Files](data-files.md)
"Frames"). It is rendered from `data/variables.csv` (the variables),
`data/codes.csv` (the value labels of the coded columns) and
`data/study_types.csv` (the study types and their groups), which go with
every release, as does this codebook. The same tables make the release's
`datapackage.json`, a [Data Package](https://datapackage.org) (v2) descriptor
of the Parquet copies of the files (`datapackage_descriptor()`).

Source: "DBH table ..." is the column of a DBH table (its Norwegian name),
"derived" or "harvest" a column the pipeline makes, and a code whose source
is "project" is defined by the project, not by DBH. Codes are DBH's unless
marked. Missing values are NA (null in Parquet).

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (f in names(RELEASE_KEYS)) {
  cat("\n## ", f, "\n\n", sep = "")
  k <- RELEASE_KEYS[[f]]
  cat("Primary key: ", paste0("`", k$primaryKey, "`", collapse = " + "), ".", sep = "")
  for (fk in k$foreignKeys) {
    cat(" Foreign key: `", fk$fields, "` → `", fk$reference$resource, ".", fk$reference$fields, "`.", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
  vf <- v[v$file == f, c("variable", "type", "source", "description")]
  vf$variable <- paste0("`", vf$variable, "`")
  vf$description <- esc(vf$description)
  print(knitr::kable(vf, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Codes

The allowed values of the coded columns, in every file that has the column.
Open DBH code lists (`language_code`, `subject_code`, `nus_code`,
`department_code`, `programme_code`) are not listed: their values are DBH's
and vary between snapshots.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (var in unique(codes$variable)) {
  cat("\n### `", var, "`\n\n", sep = "")
  cv <- codes[codes$variable == var, c("code", "label", "source", "description")]
  cv$code <- paste0("`", cv$code, "`")
  cv$description <- esc(cv$description)
  print(knitr::kable(cv, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n")
}
```
